_comment: Codex: Space Marines (11th edition) stratagems + detachment rules, generated by
scripts/40kdc/curate-from-wahapedia.mjs from the Wahapedia snapshot in
printed text. windows were INFERRED from WHEN (see _window_review) unless the codex
implementation pass CONFIRMED them (CONFIRMED_WINDOWS in the script, marked [CONFIRMED]).
duration_phrase is editorial (see orks_codex_11e.json; DURATION_PHRASES in the script).
Boarding Actions detachments are out of scope (owner decision D3).

detachments.name: Champions of Fenris
detachments.rule_text:
The Great Wolf Watches
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Character units have the following ability:
Countercharge: (Once per battle round, per unit) When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1CP.
detachments.legend: THE HAND‑PICKED CHAMPIONS OF THE SPACE WOLVES CHAPTER STRIDE OUT TO LAY THEIR ENEMIES LOW

detachments.name: Saga of the Beastslayer
detachments.rule_text:
Legendary Slayers
Attacks made by friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster/Vehicle].

detachments.name: Saga of the Great Wolf
detachments.rule_text:
Master of Wolves
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER / VEHICLE units) with this ability have the following abilities: Encircling Jaws: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls. Hunter’s Eye: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1. Ferocious Strike: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" have [Sustained Hits 1]. Friendly LOGAN GRIMNAR units have the following ability: Howling Onslaught: (Once per battle, per army) In your command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER / VEHICLE units benefit from the Master of Wolves rule until the start of your next command phase. Restrictions: Your army can include SPACE WOLVES units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

stratagems.name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.

stratagems.name: HEROIC RESOLVE
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: This warrior’s indomitable fortitude is the stuff of legend, galvanizing his pack to remain standing before an avalanche of incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: CHAMPION'S GUIDANCE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.

stratagems.name: UNBRIDLED FEROCITY
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: The Space Wolves fight with a savage fury that enables them to overcome even the most resilient targets.

stratagems.name: CO-ORDINATED STRIKE
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Space Wolves officers rein in their warriors’ impulsive fury, repositioning them to strike exposed flanks.

stratagems.name: IMPETUOSITY
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Severe losses only drive Blood Claws and Wulfen forward into the midst of the foe.

stratagems.name: BATTLE INSTINCTS
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: These champions of Fenris respond to enemy fire with instinctive swiftness, rarely giving their foes a second chance to shoot at them.

stratagems.name: GRIMNAR'S COMMAND
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Pivotal as they are to the Great Wolf’s plans, this pack have their own orders to fulfil in this moment that come directly from Grimnar himself.

stratagems.name: FENRISIAN FEROCITY
stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Even the most challenging terrain or formidable fortifications cannot stop the Great Wolf’s chief hunters once they are in motion.

stratagems.name: FANGS OF THE PACK
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Fighting as one, these champions of Fenris fall upon an enemy champion and drag them down with single-minded savagery.

stratagems.name: WOLF TOTEMS
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Be it the power of belief or something a little more eldritch, the Space Wolves’ trust in their various protective amulets and totems is often borne out.

stratagems.name: EYE OF THE PACK
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.
stratagems.source: Wahapedia wh40k11ed/factions/space-marines/ (export 2026-10-21 16:06:23). Flavour: Once a pack of Fenrisian warriors has perceived some slight weakness in the defences of a foe, they all strike at once, like encircling predators dragging down their prey.
